messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran a 8xA100 job (tp=2, pp=2) on staging and saw a weird perf cliff when sequence length hit ~250 tokens. traces attached in perf-bot link below.

rajiv: hmm, did you try nvprof / nccl topo? could be NVLink islanding between the two pairs.

maria: perf-bot posted flamegraph: https://perf.internal/runs/1932106789. Main symptom: all-reduce stalls ~30-70ms every 4th microbatch, causing tail latency spikes.

perf-bot: [automated] Profile summary: 8xA100, batch=32, seq_dist median=180, mean=210. Observed: repeated wait on NCCL allReduce, 40% idle kernel time on ranks 2 and 5. KV-cache hit rate drops 12% at seq>240.

oliver: That kv-cache drop is suspicious — are we invalidating prefixes when switching kernels? we recently added a fallback path to the generic matmul kernel for odd seqs.

maria: Yes — kernel selector falls back to generic GEMM for seq>192 when the fused attention kernel fails heuristics. I think fallback triggers a different KV layout and causes cache thrash across TP shards.

rajiv: If the fallback changes memory layout, we'd force an all-reduce barrier for KV sync. Also NVLink topology can amplify imbalance: one NVLink island has slightly higher latency so its all-reduce participants lag and stall the rest.

oliver: Quick experiments: can you rerun with --kernel-force=fused_attn for seq up to 512 and --comm-overlap=async? I'm curious if overlap hides the stalls.

maria: started a run with those flags. preliminary: tail p99 dropped from 480ms to 210ms, but avg CPU usage for process pinned to ranks 2/5 still higher. KV-cache hit stayed stable.

sophia: Nice. That suggests two problems: (1) kernel selector optimistic fallback causing layout mismatch; (2) NCCL communicator grouping needs topology awareness. We should avoid mixing ranks across NVLink islands in the same TP group.

rajiv: Agreed. Proposed mitigations: 1) make kernel selector preserve KV layout when falling back (add a layout adapter or avoid fallback that mutates layout), 2) update placement allocator to prefer NVLink-connected ranks for TP groups, 3) enable async all-reduce overlap by default for multi-node or hybrid TP/PP configs.

oliver: I'll open a PR for the kernel selector change — adapter shim that remaps kv indices during fallback. Also add a unit test that simulates seq boundary transitions.

maria: I'll file a placement tweak ticket and add a repro job matrix (nvlink/pcie/efa) so we can validate across fabrics.

perf-bot: [automated] New issue created: INF-7623 "Preserve KV layout on fused->generic fallback" by oliver.

rajiv: One more thought: on EFA nodes the network noise pattern is different — we saw smaller, more frequent stalls instead of periodic big stalls. Keep those in repro too.

sophia: Good call. Let's triage after oliver's PR lands. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: TL;DR: kernel fallback + NVLink islanding + KV layout mismatch = periodic all-reduce stall. Plan: kernel shim PR, placement advisor, enable async overlap, repro matrix across NVLink/PCIe/EFA.
